sql: SELECT c.name, c.slug, l.id AS lp_id, l.hero->>'cta_mode' AS cta_mode, l.hero->>'cta_text' AS cta_text, l.hero->>'whatsapp_number' AS hero_whats, (SELECT whatsapp_numbers FROM company_onboarding o WHERE o.company_id = c.id) AS onboarding_whats, (SELECT string_agg(coalesce(w.unit,'') || ':' || coalesce(w.phone_number,'') || ':' || w.is_active::text, ' | ') FROM wapi_instances w WHERE w.company_id = c.id) AS numeros FROM companies c JOIN company_landing_pages l ON l.company_id = c.id WHERE c.slug ILIKE '%planeta%' OR c.name ILIKE '%planeta%'
